Chat.Title: AI Chat
Chat.Explanation: MCP is the editor tool connection, not a relay to another AI app. Connect MCP and select a model adapter to chat. Nothing is sent to the model until you press Send. History and credentials are kept in memory only.
Chat.Endpoint: Full Chat Completions endpoint (local HTTP or external HTTPS)
Chat.Key: API key (optional for local servers; not saved)
Chat.CompatiblePrivacy: Prompts and session history go to this endpoint. If project sharing is enabled, graph tool results (including node names, values and asset references) also go there. The endpoint operator determines retention. Requires Chat Completions function tools; Copilot, Codex and Gemini CLIs are NOT compatible endpoints. Trusted DLL adapters can be added in Extensions settings.
Chat.Share: I explicitly allow graph tool results to be sent to the destination shown above for this session
Chat.Input: Ask about an effect, or request a graph change…
Chat.Offline: Offline. Input is disabled until authenticated editor MCP connects and an adapter is selected.
Chat.Connecting: Connecting to authenticated local editor MCP; no model request is being made…
Chat.Connected: Editor MCP verified; selected model adapter ready to request. Model availability is checked only when sending.
Chat.ConnectFailed: Cannot connect. Check the MCP server, endpoint, model ID and adapter configuration. No model request was sent.
Chat.ConnectionLost: Editor MCP connection lost. Input disabled; session cleared. A tool already submitted might have completed: inspect the graph and Undo history before retrying.
Chat.Cancelled: Cancelled. No further model requests or tools will be started. A submitted tool may already have completed; inspect the graph and Undo history before retrying.
Chat.Cleared: Conversation cleared and disconnected. Credentials remain only in the masked field until the window closes.
Chat.ConsentChanged: Sharing consent changed. Disconnected and cleared the prior session; reconnect to continue.
Chat.AdaptersChanged: Available adapters changed. Disconnected and cleared the session; select an adapter again.
Chat.ContextChanged: Document, graph level or revision changed since the previous reply. Disconnected and cleared stale context; your unsent input is preserved. Reconnect before sending.
Chat.Confirmation: Waiting for explicit approval of the model's graph operation…
Chat.ToolRunning: Calling the authenticated editor MCP tool…
Chat.SendFailed: Request failed, returned an invalid tool call, or the document/graph revision changed. Conversation state cleared; no success is inferred. Inspect any completed graph edits before retrying.
Chat.Limit: Session safety limit reached. Clear the conversation or shorten the message. Completed edits remain in Undo history.
Chat.Tool: Editor MCP result (model input with sharing enabled)
Chat.ConfirmExplanation: Review this exact tool and its JSON arguments before it runs on the currently active document and graph level. This may edit or navigate the graph. Changes use the editor's existing validation, locks and history.
